slides.headline: Two women, one officer. Who is he *with*?
A steam launch on the busy *Thames*.
A naval officer lounges back, very *relaxed*.
On one side, a lady looks away, *serious*.
Behind him, a second woman peeks *out*.
Two black umbrellas, two women, one *man*.
Even a little dog is along for the *ride*.
His hand hangs loose. No *duty* today.
Look below: a basket of champagne *bottles*.
The British flag flies over their little *party*.
Around them, the port works hard, full of *smoke*.
Victorian critics were shocked. Who is he *with*?
